wave_evidence.claim: Bucket-2 (locator-expressible, no-new-mechanism) density on COMMANDER_SPINE.template.json is 9/19 (~47%), per the wave-2 N=3 panel measurement the launch order cites.
wave_evidence.expected: Other templates in the corpus would partition similarly if the extrapolation to ~31/65 corpus-wide held.
wave_evidence.observed: Final, complete corpus measurement across all 8 templates: COMMANDER_SPINE 8/19 (42%), ADMIRAL_SPINE 3/10 (30%), EXPLORER_SPINE 3/10 (30%), CHARTER 1/10 (10%), IMPLEMENTER_PLAN 0/3 (0%), SCOUT 1/3-of-remaining-candidates (25% of its full 4), CARTOGRAPHER 0/4 (0%), EXECUTE_PLAN 0/4 (0%). 16 of 65 total (~25%), materially below the ~31 extrapolated. 5 of the 7 non-COMMANDER_SPINE templates fall outside the [30%,65%] band, all low-side, correlated cleanly with template shape: rich top-level orchestrator spines (COMMANDER_SPINE, ADMIRAL_SPINE, EXPLORER_SPINE) land in-band; thin gate-order/child-plan/bootstrap-once/report-focused scaffolding (CHARTER, EXECUTE_PLAN, IMPLEMENTER_PLAN, SCOUT, CARTOGRAPHER) lands at or below the low edge, with two clean structural zeros (EXECUTE_PLAN, IMPLEMENTER_PLAN) and a third near-zero (CARTOGRAPHER, foreclosed by this run's own DEGRADED-UNPARSEABLE map state, not by template shape alone).

discrepancies.signal: The launch order's extrapolated ~31/65 corpus-wide bucket-2 estimate assumed the 9/19 (47%) COMMANDER_SPINE rate generalizes uniformly. This run's own fresh, per-condition measurement across the 7 non-COMMANDER_SPINE templates finds a materially lower rate: 5 of 7 fall outside the [30%,65%] band, all low-side, and EXECUTE_PLAN measured a clean, structural 0%.
